angularDiameterSource: Radius 1.842 ± 0.019 solar radii from Mamajek (2012), ApJ 754, L20, using the VLTI limb-darkened angular diameter 2.223 ± 0.022 mas.
distanceSource: Inverse of the Hipparcos new-reduction parallax 129.81 ± 0.47 mas (van Leeuwen 2007) via SIMBAD
radiusSource: Radius: Radius 1.842 ± 0.019 solar radii from Mamajek (2012), ApJ 754, L20, using the VLTI limb-darkened angular diameter 2.223 ± 0.022 mas. Adopted 1,281,479 km, 1.8420 solar radii at 695700 km per solar radius. No gravitational parameter is adopted. presentationUp: the display axis (celestial north at the star) is up; no spin axis is adopted.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Effective temperature 8590 ± 73 K from Mamajek 2012 (ApJL 754, L20; https://doi.org/10.1088/2041-8205/754/2/L20), Section 2 and Table 2: the Absil et al. 2009 VLTI diameter with the Davis et al. 2005 bolometric flux.

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius in the shared neutral gray; no picture of the photosphere is cast.
